release_notes: Landings can now pass a visitor's choice to the offer the Keitaro way: add sub_id_1 … sub_id_30 to the transition link (/?_lp=1&sub_id_5=…, or {lp_url}&sub_id_5=… on a landing hosted elsewhere) and they update the click, so the offer URL's {sub_id_5} carries the chosen product, plan or answer to the network. Values are stored on the click too, so reports and postbacks see them. Empty values never erase what the traffic source sent.
